name: test-forge
displayName: TestForge — Autonomous QA & Security Testing Suite
description: Strict, stack-aware automated QA & Security Testing plugin for Web (Next.js/React), Mobile (Flutter/React Native), Backend (Node/Python/Spring Boot), Firebase, and more: auto-detects project stack, blocks secrets in real time, runs functional/regression/security/pentest/load suites, saves docs/qa/TEST_FORGE_REPORT.md, and awaits user approval before fixes.
suggestedPrompts: Use test-auto to detect my project stack, run all applicable QA & security tests, and generate docs/qa/TEST_FORGE_REPORT.md
Use test-security to launch a deep Red-Team security audit and local pentest before production
Use test-functional to write missing unit, integration, E2E, and regression tests for my latest changes
